esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; SN-GCJA5 laser particulate matter sensor (I2C) needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x33. Added the sn_gcja5.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; SN-GCJA5 laser particulate matter sensor (I2C) needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. It shares the I2C bus (SDA GP4, SCL GP5) at address 0x33. Added the sn_gcja5.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes
